parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u."name"),''), u."email") AS "fullName", COALESCE(NULLIF(s."startTime",''), a."expectedAt", '10:30') AS "expectedAt", NULLIF(TRIM(a."arrivedAt"),'') AS "arrivedAt", CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(a."entryText",'')) IN ('FALTA','VACACIONES','DESCANSO','DESC','PAGO','PAGO DIA','PAGO DÍA','CONTEO') THEN UPPER(a."entryText") ELSE NULL END AS "entryText", s.status AS "schedStatus" FROM "Schedule" s JOIN "User" u ON u.id = s."userId" LEFT JOIN "Attendance" a ON a."userId" = s."userId" AND to_char(a."date" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Monterrey','YYYY-MM-DD') = to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Monterrey'),'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE s."storeId" = 'clarvex-demo-store' AND u."active" = true AND u."checklistOnly" = false AND u."isDemo" = false AND s.status = 'WORKING' AND to_char(s."date" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Monterrey','YYYY-MM-DD') = to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Monterrey'),'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY "fullName";

SELECT to_char(fecha, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dia, ventas, meta, tickets, piezas, con_captura, ventas_semana, meta_semana, ultima_captura, por_persona FROM agente_tienda.cierre_por_dia WHERE fecha = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Monterrey')::date
